name: Stripe Link CLI
summary: Lets agents get one-time-use payment credentials from a Link wallet (virtual card, Link Pay Token or MPP Shared Payment Token) with user approval.
description: `npm i -g @stripe/link-cli`; ships agent skills (`npx skills add stripe/link-cli`) and a local MCP mode (`--mcp`). Shared Payment Tokens work with sellers accepting Machine Payments Protocol (MPP); Link Pay Tokens use WebMCP on Stripe checkout. Currently US and Canadian Link accounts only.
